title: Introduce intake quickcheck CLI and localized release-brief generator
author: Asha Patel
description:
Motivation: Onboarding reviewers and downstream product owners often need concise, translated release briefs for model updates. Manual translation and privacy-aware redaction are causing delays in rollouts across EMEA/APAC. This PR adds a small intake quickcheck CLI that runs deterministic probe replays and emits a compact, privacy-aware release brief in one or more locales.

What this PR does: Adds 'rmd-intake-quickcheck' (CLI) that: runs a configurable set of probes against a candidate model bundle in a sandbox, extracts a compact performance summary, and synthesizes a release brief using templates per-locale. The generator supports: en, es, fr, de, ja by default and a pluggable translator adapter for additional locales. It also applies redaction rules for detected PII and sensitive sample text in briefs. The onboarding manifest schema gains an optional 'release_brief_locales' field to pin locales for automatic generation. A small migration script converts existing manifests with default locale sets.

Checklist: 
- [x] CLI implementation and documentation (quickstart) 
- [x] Release brief templates and locale mappings 
- [x] Privacy redaction rules + tests 
- [x] Translator adapter interface + fallback to English 
- [x] Integration test that runs a mocked probe replay and validates brief output 
- [x] Migration script for existing manifests 

Commits (high-level): 
- Add CLI entrypoint and probe-replay harness (5f3a1c)
- Locale templates and translation adapter with offline glossary (9b7d22)
- PII redaction rules and unit tests (c2a4be)
- Manifest schema bump + migration script (d448f1)
- Add integration tests and CI tweaks (e7f0a9)

Files changed (high level): 
- cmd/rmd-intake-quickcheck/main.go (CLI and config parsing)
- internal/probereplay/runner.go (small harness for replaying probes)
- internal/briefgen/templates/* (per-locale templates and example placeholders)
- internal/briefgen/translator_adapter.go (adapter interface + offline glossary implementation)
- pkg/onboard/schema/v2/manifest.json (schema bump + example changes)
- tools/migrations/migrate-release-brief-locales.go (migration helper)
- tests/integration/quickcheck_locales_test.go (integration test using mocked translator)
- docs/quickstarts/intake-quickcheck.md (how-to + examples)

CI: Initially e2e flaked due to mocked translator timeout; fixed by adding a deterministic offline adapter and retry logic in the test. Final CI status: unit/integration/lint all green.

Why this is safe: The CLI and brief generator are opt-in. The manifest change is non-breaking (new optional field). The migration script is reversible and guarded behind a dry-run flag. PII redaction uses a conservative heuristic; we err on redacting ambiguous tokens and log redaction summaries for audit.

Related work: ENG-4762 (onboard telemetry improvements), ENG-5121 (release notes automation).

Notes for reviewers: Focus on the redaction rule coverage and fallback behaviour for missing locale translations. We should confirm legal/compliance signoff is OK with the conservative redaction strategy before enabling auto-generation for enterprise bundles.

release_notes: Add intake quickcheck CLI and localized release brief generation. Optional manifest field 'release_brief_locales' introduced; migration helper provided. Auto-redaction for PII applied to generated briefs.
review_comments_summary: Diego: requested a short-term disable flag for auto-generation in enterprise workflows; implemented. Maya: asked for explicit fallback semantics and audit logs for redactions; added logs and fallback to English. Tom: asked for more unit coverage around redaction heuristics; tests added. All reviewers approved after fixes.
notes_for_ops: When enabling in production, set translation adapter to offline glossary or approved cloud translator. Enable audit logging for redaction summaries. Migration should be run in dry-run first; the tool logs changed manifests to S3-style archive.
test_plan_summary: Unit tests for translator and redaction heuristics; integration test runs a mocked probe replay and asserts localized template fields; CI includes an integration stage that exercises the migration script in dry-run mode.
